'''Dust Viper Den''' was the main base of the [[Dust Vipers]] criminal gang operating in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After a noted criminal [[Bel Nerodia]] took over the gang, he quickly made Dust Vipers into a force to be reckoned with, establishing the Den near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: The Dust Vipers}}</ref> In [[3630 BBY]] the Dust Vipers ambushed an [[Eternal Alliance]] supply convoy and obtained security plans for the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. This prompted the Alliance to retaliate against the Dust Vipers and a task force was [[Destruction of the Dust Vipers|sent into]] the compound. Bel Nerodia himself confronted the group, but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dust Viper Den appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.
